notes: The official Stanford PDF was verified as complete, unencrypted, and 428 physical pages. Its four-page contents list eight numbered chapters, 100 numbered chapter sections, Appendix A, Appendix B, and an index. Printed body pagination runs 1–422; physical PDF pages equal printed pages plus 6, with the title/blank leaves and Contents on PDF pages 1–6. Chapter starts were spot-checked at PDF pages 7, 71, 101, 143, 217, 257, 301, and 341; Appendix A starts at 409, Appendix B at 419, and the index at 421. Three chapter-boundary shards are balanced at 142, 158, and 128 physical pages. No broad reuse license is stated in the PDF, so access is classified as full because the complete work is openly served from Stanford's official course-material host, without implying redistribution rights.
